privileged_info_for_vlm: PDB 1AOI is a nucleosome core particle. DNA chains are typically I and J. Histone chains are: H3 (A, E), H4 (B, F), H2A (C, G), and H2B (D, H). The agent must find residues within 3.5 Angstroms of DNA; expect many Arginine (ARG) and Lysine (LYS) residues as they are positively charged and interact with the DNA backbone. The report must contain at least 8 specific residues and identify which histone type (H2A, H2B, H3, or H4) has the highest contact count.
